events.factual_description: Roulette presents Ka Baird & Chris Ryan Williams' Enthalpy record release with Leila Bordreuil & Luke Stewart on Thursday, December 17, 2026 at 8:00 PM, with doors at 7:00 PM. Roulette lists $25 advance admission, $30 at the door, and $20 student/senior admission with ID. Baird and Williams perform material around Enthalpy, identified by Roulette as their first duo album on Outside Time Records, with Baird on flutes, voice and electronics and Williams on trumpet and electronics. A separate duo set pairs cellist Leila Bordreuil and double bassist Luke Stewart in music exploring feedback, improvisation and the expanded sonic possibilities of their instruments. Roulette states that the performance will also be livestreamed free and archived.

en.why_it_matters: The hook is the shape of the night rather than a name on a marquee: Baird's flutes, voice and electronics meet Williams' trumpet and electronics around their first duo album, then Bordreuil and Stewart strip the second set down to cello, double bass, feedback and free improvisation. It is a compact survey of how acoustic instruments can be pushed into electroacoustic and noise territory without losing the physical identity of breath, brass, bow and strings.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already convenient, this is worth folding into a Brooklyn night at Roulette. From the DMV, I would not build a dedicated round trip around this date alone; pair it with another strong reason to be in the city.
en.listen_before: Enthalpy is scheduled for release on September 25, 2026; no exact Apple Music destination was verified before release.

es.why_it_matters: La gracia está en la forma de la noche, no sólo en los nombres del cartel: las flautas, la voz y la electrónica de Baird se cruzan con la trompeta y la electrónica de Williams alrededor de su primer disco a dúo; después Bordreuil y Stewart reducen todo a cello, contrabajo, feedback e improvisación libre. Es una muestra muy concreta de cómo empujar instrumentos acústicos hacia el terreno electroacústico y del noise sin perder la identidad física del aliento, el metal, el arco y las cuerdas.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya te queda a mano, la metería en una noche de Brooklyn alrededor de Roulette. Desde el DMV no armaría un viaje dedicado únicamente por esta fecha; la combinaría con otra razón fuerte para estar en la ciudad.
es.listen_before: Enthalpy está anunciado para el 25 de septiembre de 2026; antes del lanzamiento no quedó verificado un destino exacto en Apple Music.
